mcp_tools.name: release_readiness_verdict
mcp_tools.title: Release-readiness verdict
mcp_tools.description: Submit a release-evidence manifest; get a deterministic READY / NOT_READY / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across five release bars (control, understanding, management, lifecycle, stability) with per-check evidence.

inputSchema.description: The release-evidence manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table).

version_bump_locations.description: Places the version was bumped; must name exactly one.

tag.description: Release tag evidence: {name: 'v<version>', annotated: bool, moved: bool}.

approver.description: Named human who owns and approves the release.

artifacts.description: Artifact evidence: {sealed: bool, checksum_manifest: bool, verified_before_announcement: bool}.

expect.notes: All 19 checks pass. Computed spot checks: 19 pass, 0 fail, 0 missing.
Rollback plan is not testable and health check window is outside 24-48 hour requirement.
Only product and version provided; all other required fields are absent.
